closing_report_open_gaps_not_closed.why: entity_schema_3.0.json defines no limit - no number, no unit, no reference. Verified directly at v2.0.0.
closing_report_open_gaps_not_closed.consequence: R3 cannot be granted by this suite on the freshness dimension at all.

closing_report_open_gaps_not_closed.why: The schema declares value_type range for two parameters and never defines its structure.
closing_report_open_gaps_not_closed.consequence: VT-005 can assert container type only. Both affected parameters are OPTIONAL, so low consequence today.

closing_report_open_gaps_not_closed.why: compiled_on and compiled_by are stamped at promotion, but nothing in the record distinguishes a legitimate pre-promotion draft from a promoted record that lost its stamps.
closing_report_open_gaps_not_closed.consequence: TL-001B reports absence at info severity and cannot tell the two cases apart. TL-008 catches only the incoherent combination of missing stamps plus a declared R2/R3.

closing_report_open_gaps_not_closed.gap: R2 and R3 partially unverifiable after calibration exclusion
closing_report_open_gaps_not_closed.why: The schema's R2 definition includes calibration coherence and its R3 definition includes held-out anchors; both are out of scope for this run by direction.
closing_report_open_gaps_not_closed.consequence: R2 verified on 4 of 5 clauses, R3 on 1 of 3. Seven v1.1.0 tests were removed, including XF-005, which caught an anchor being used to both fit and test a parameter - the failure mode that produces a validation result looking like a successful fit while the model reproduces its own input.

closing_report_open_gaps_not_closed.gap: RR3 escalation-marker clause has no operative effect at R1
closing_report_open_gaps_not_closed.why: RR3's "ONLY IF" phrasing implies an unmarked field hard-fails at R1, but the following sentence states it is a warning at R1, and the R2 clause fails both cases regardless.
closing_report_open_gaps_not_closed.consequence: Implemented per the later, unambiguous sentence - warn either way at R1, under distinct finding codes. If strictness was intended, CC-002B must be raised to fail and this suite is currently under-strict at R1.

closing_report_open_gaps_not_closed.why: SQS1 and SQS5 require a source_quote for every non-null value; INV12 says the four class-typical constants are shipped pre-populated and not re-researched.
closing_report_open_gaps_not_closed.consequence: If those constants ship without source_quotes, every catalog record fails SQS-001 and SQS-005 on four paths for reasons unrelated to the author's work. Implemented without a carve-out, as specified, and flagged.

closing_report_open_gaps_not_closed.gap: source_quote and conflicting are not schema-declared
closing_report_open_gaps_not_closed.why: Verified directly - neither string appears anywhere in entity_schema_3.0.json.
closing_report_open_gaps_not_closed.consequence: The six SQS tests and CC-010 test fields catalog.py does not know about. A SQS failure is a requirements failure, not a schema-conformance failure, and the two should not be reported as the same thing.

closing_report_open_gaps_not_closed.why: RR4 enumerates nine REQUIRED_MODELING paths; the schema declares ten.
closing_report_open_gaps_not_closed.consequence: The tenth is checked under the generic REQUIRED_MODELING rule only, at warn level.

closing_report_open_gaps_not_closed.gap: segment attribution is asserted, never verified
closing_report_open_gaps_not_closed.why: The suite asserts the segment recorded in its header. It cannot check that header value is right, and the coverage plan registers both a defense and a commercial segment under the identical category string "UAS - Group 1 - Quadcopter".
closing_report_open_gaps_not_closed.consequence: A wrong segment_id fails no test here - it passes XF-010, XF-013 and TL-006 - and miscounts two segments at once. Not currently live: at v2.2.0 the X2D (defense variant) and SEG-US-DEF-2020S-QUAD-G1 (defense segment) agree, so this is a standing check. It WAS live at v2.1.0, which is the evidence that a variant change can invalidate it silently.

closing_report_open_gaps_not_closed.why: The scope declares the record represents the X2D in standard configuration on the stock battery, and that X2E or alternate-configuration sources are conflicts rather than fills. Detecting that requires reading the source behind a value.
closing_report_open_gaps_not_closed.consequence: A record populated entirely from X2E sources passes every test in this suite. Sharpened by four identity changes - any value researched during the X2DENTERPRISE or X2E windows is a wrong-aircraft value unless re-confirmed against X2D sources. Human review at promotion is the only control.

explicitly_out_of_scope: Whether any sourced value is factually correct. A record can pass every test above and state the wrong mass.
Whether a source_quote is authentic, real, or supports the value it sits beside. Only its structural shape is tested. See SQS-006.
Whether a cited source actually supports the value cited to it. SC-004, CC-004, CC-005 and CC-005B check that a source or note string EXISTS and is non-empty. None reads it.
Whether the aerodynamic_assumptions literature values are the right modelling choices. CC-003 and CC-004 confirm they carry an acceptable confidence tier and a source. The choice is not graded.
CALIBRATION, entirely - presence, block structure, anchor existence, fitted-versus-held-out separation, and fit accuracy. Out of scope for this run by direction. See OI-13.
